; Normalisation 6 (debug-paths): a function carrying full debug information.
source_filename = "one-directory/sink.c"

declare void @llvm.dbg.value(metadata, metadata, metadata)

define i32 @sink(ptr %p, i32 %v) !dbg !7 {
entry:
  call void @llvm.dbg.value(metadata i32 %v, metadata !13, metadata !DIExpression()), !dbg !10
  store i32 %v, ptr %p, align 4, !dbg !10
  %0 = load i32, ptr %p, align 4, !dbg !11
  ret i32 %0, !dbg !12
}

!llvm.dbg.cu = !{!0}
!llvm.module.flags = !{!3, !4}

!0 = distinct !DICompileUnit(language: DW_LANG_C11, file: !1, producer: "a", isOptimized: false, runtimeVersion: 0, emissionKind: FullDebug, splitDebugInlining: false, nameTableKind: None)
!1 = !DIFile(filename: "sink.c", directory: "/one/directory")
!3 = !{i32 7, !"Dwarf Version", i32 5}
!4 = !{i32 2, !"Debug Info Version", i32 3}
!7 = distinct !DISubprogram(name: "sink", scope: !1, file: !1, line: 1, type: !8, scopeLine: 1, spFlags: DISPFlagDefinition, unit: !0)
!8 = !DISubroutineType(types: !9)
!9 = !{null}
!10 = !DILocation(line: 2, column: 3, scope: !7)
!11 = !DILocation(line: 3, column: 3, scope: !7)
!12 = !DILocation(line: 4, column: 3, scope: !7)
!13 = !DILocalVariable(name: "v", scope: !7, file: !1, line: 1, type: !14)
!14 = !DIBasicType(name: "int", size: 32, encoding: DW_ATE_signed)
